data.description: A gated residential community in Dubailand featuring deluxe villas and apartments with golf course views.

data.answer:
The Living Legends stands out for its modern amenities, including smart home technology, quick-response emergency services, and a delivery grocery store for ultimate convenience. Families favor this secure, gated neighborhood due to its proximity to essential facilities such as a Carrefour supermarket, schools, a mosque, a boutique center, a clinic, and various shopping destinations. 

Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate the open spaces, lush gardens, and dedicated children’s play areas, providing a perfect blend of recreation and relaxation for residents of all ages.

Living Legends community offers a wide range of properties for both rent and sale, making it a prime choice for those seeking versatile housing options. It features studios, 1 to 3-bedroom apartments, and 4 to 6-bedroom villas.
There are a total of 2,200 apartments and 500 standalone villas. These properties cater to various lifestyle preferences and family sizes, ensuring there’s something for everyone.

The villas in Living Legends Dubailand stand out with their spacious layouts and luxurious features. Divided into four types—A, B, C, and D—these homes offer unique living experiences. Type A and Type B are located near the scenic golf course, while Type C and Type D are surrounded by lush landscaped gardens. Each villa comes equipped with a maid’s room, a separate family area, walk-in closets, a guest bathroom, and large windows to take in the serene surroundings.

Similarly, apartments in Living Legends Dubai feature chic interiors and modern layouts. Each residential building is equipped with its own swimming pool, gym, and basement parking. The flats include open-style kitchens, en-suite bathrooms, built-in wardrobes, guest washrooms, and balconies—some even offering two balconies for added comfort.

Popular Sub-Communities in Living Legends

  • D Villas: Nestled within the lush greenery of Living Legends, D Villas offers expansive layouts with 4 to 6 bedrooms. These homes provide modern amenities, including maid’s rooms and family areas, making them a popular choice for families seeking luxurious living in this community.
  • B Villas: Located adjacent to the golf course, B Villas in the Living Legends community offer scenic views and spacious interiors. These villas feature contemporary designs and landscaped surroundings, ideal for those who value comfort and elegance.
  • Cleopatra Tower: A standout in Living Legends apartments Dubai, Cleopatra Tower features 1 to 3-bedroom apartments with open-plan kitchens, built-in wardrobes, and balconies. 
  • C Villas: Offering a serene environment, C Villas in Living Legends Dubai are surrounded by landscaped gardens and peaceful lakes. These spacious homes come with walk-in closets, guest bathrooms, and modern layouts, catering to a refined lifestyle.
  • Hercules Tower: It offers elegant apartments designed for modern living. With features like en-suite bathrooms, chic interiors, and access to top-notch facilities.

Renting a Property in Living Legends

Renting a property here offers a range of options to suit various preferences. Apartments are available for rent between AED 43k and AED 300k per year, with an average rental value of AED 89k per annum.

Villas, on the other hand, have an average rental price of AED 188,930 per annum.

Buying a Property in Living Legends

Properties in Living Legends Dubai for sale offer an excellent opportunity to invest in a vibrant and well-planned community. With options ranging from elegant apartments to spacious villas, property prices start from approximately AED 400k for apartments and go up to AED 4.5M for villas.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in the Living Legends Dubai?

data.answer:
Life in Living Legends Dubai is serene yet vibrant, with lush green spaces, scenic lakes, and a welcoming community atmosphere. Residents enjoy modern amenities, including a golf course, retail center, and family-friendly facilities, making it an ideal place to call home.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Living Legends

Living Legends Dubai villas come with private garages or parking spaces, ensuring ample parking for residents. Similarly, the residential towers in Living Legends feature dedicated basement parking areas, adding convenience for apartment dwellers. 

The nearest metro station to the community is City Center Deira Metro Station. 

Supermarkets in and Around Living Legends

The neighborhood features a convenient Carrefour supermarket catering to the daily needs of residents. Additionally, several supermarkets are located in nearby areas, including Viva Supermarket and Grandiose Supermarket in Majan.

Shopping Mall in and Near Living Legends

Residents can shop conveniently at Andalusia Courtyard Mall, located within the community. Nearby, Remal Mall in Majan offers a mix of shopping, dining, and leisure options. 

Midtown Central Majan Shopping Center, situated in Wadi Al Safa 3, features 38 retail units, including a restaurant, café, supermarket, shisha spots, and a clinic, providing a comprehensive shopping experience close to Living Legends.

Schools and Nurseries in and Near Living Legends

Within the community, Odyssey Nursery is a popular choice, located just a 4-minute drive away. Beyond its regular curriculum, this nursery engages toddlers with summer and spring camps, providing a fun and enriching environment.

For older children, several renowned schools are accessible near Living Legends Dubailand. Dunecrest American School, located in the nearby Al Barari community, offers a robust educational framework. The GEMS Winchester School Dubai, part of the prestigious GEMS Education network, provides a British curriculum for students from the Foundation Stage to Year 13. 

Another excellent choice is the Jumeirah English Speaking School (JESS) in Arabian Ranches, a non-profit institution offering the National Curriculum of England. Its location near Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E11) ensures easy access for residents of Living Legends.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and Near Living Legends

The Living Legends Mosque is conveniently located within the community, providing a place of worship for residents. For additional options, Muslims can visit Al Barari Mosque, Masjid Hussain Abdulla Albahri, and Masjid Jama Al Rasheed, all situated within a 4 to 10-minute drive.

While there is no church within the Living Legends community, residents can reach several churches, including Haley’s Church, The Gatekeepers Weekday Warehouse, Old Apostolic Church, Fellowship Church, and Coza Church, within a 30-minute drive.

Clinics and Hospitals in and Near Living Legends

The closest medical facilities include the Dr. Kamkar Medical & Physiotherapy Center, known for its specialized treatments, Mediclinic Arabian Ranches, which offers comprehensive healthcare services, and Prime Medical Center, a trusted option for residents seeking quality medical care. 

Location & Nearby Areas

Living Legends Dubailand is surrounded by vibrant communities like Majan, a residential district nearby, and Al Barari Dubai, featuring a gated enclave of luxury villas. Close to the community, is the City of Arabia with skyscrapers, a giant mall, and IMG Worlds of Adventure.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Living Legends, Dubailand

data.answer:
The community offers plenty of activities, from golfing at the nine-hole course to enjoying outdoor spaces, playgrounds, and community events. Let’s take a look at all the things residents can do whilst living here. 

Restaurants

Popular restaurants near Living Legends Dubailand include LOWE Dubai, Mirchi Restaurant, Purple Fork, Terracotta Cafe & Restaurant, and Kabab Rolls Al Barari, offering a variety of cuisines to satisfy diverse tastes.

Beaches Near Living Legends

Al Sufouh Beach is located nearby, known for its serene ambiance, is one of the most peaceful spots in Dubai, perfect for playing sports, enjoying a picnic, or capturing stunning photos. Another great option is Jumeirah Public Beach in Umm Suqeim 3, where visitors can take strolls, go cycling, explore activities at Safa Park, or indulge in nearby dining options.

Hotels Around Living Legends

Within a 15-minute drive from the community, several hotels offer convenient accommodations. The Radisson Blu Hotel in Dubai's Deira Creek area provides easy access to the city's attractions.

Additionally, the Kempinski Hotel Mall of the Emirates, located on Sheikh Zayed Road offers luxury stays adjacent to the Mall of the Emirates.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

Living Legends offers a variety of outdoor activities and fitness facilities for residents. The community is home to a remarkable 9-hole golf club designed by renowned Swiss architect Peter Harradine, making it a haven for golf enthusiasts. 

Fitness amenities include a swimming pool, a fully equipped gym, an outdoor jacuzzi, and a dedicated children’s play area. Residents can also unwind at the community park, perfect for spending quality time with family and friends.
For fitness enthusiasts, gyms near Living Legends include Body Language Health Club in Al Barari, Oryx Fit Dubai, Fitness Holidays in Majan, Fitness First in Motor City, and Optimal Fitness in Dubai Studio City. 

For beauty and relaxation, residents can visit nearby salons and spas such as Heart & Soul Spa, The Iridium Spa, The White Room Spa, and Nad Al Sheba Health Club & Spa.

Community Events

Residents can explore nearby communities like Al Barari and Arabian Ranches 3, which are renowned for their year-round calendar of exciting events and activities.

Attractions and Landmarks

The area is conveniently located near several notable landmarks. Residents can enjoy thrilling experiences at IMG Worlds of Adventure and Global Village. Other nearby highlights include the luxurious Al Habtoor Polo Resort and the historic Al Marmoom Heritage Village, offering diverse recreational and cultural experiences.

Living Legends Dubai offers a serene lifestyle with modern amenities and a family-friendly environment. The community’s strategic location near key landmarks and vibrant neighborhoods ensures convenience for residents. Its peaceful ambiance and range of facilities make it an ideal choice for a balanced lifestyle.

What types of properties are available in Living Legends Dubai?

The area offers a mix of properties, including studios, 1 to 3-bedroom apartments, and 4 to 6-bedroom villas. These homes are designed to cater to families, professionals, and investors, featuring modern layouts, spacious interiors, and luxurious amenities.

How is the connectivity to major areas from Living Legends Dubai?

It is strategically located in Dubailand, with easy access to key roads like Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road. It’s approximately 20 minutes from Downtown Dubai and Dubai International Airport, making it well-connected to the city's main hubs.

What makes Living Legends Dubai a family-friendly community?

The community offers a secure, gated environment with access to schools, nurseries, parks, and playgrounds. Amenities such as a Carrefour supermarket, a community mosque, and dedicated children’s play areas make it an ideal choice for families.

What recreational options are available for residents?

Living Legends boasts a 9-hole golf course, community parks, fitness facilities, and outdoor spaces for relaxation and sports. Nearby attractions like IMG Worlds of Adventure, Global Village, and Al Barari's lush gardens add to the recreational offerings.

data.content:
Living Legends Dubai is a sought-after gated community in Dubailand, offering a mix of 500 luxurious villas and modern apartments in 12 different residential towers. Nestled in a prime location, the community is designed to cater to families and professionals alike, combining comfort, convenience, and serenity.

Spread across 14 million sq. ft., Living Legends Dubailand features a retail center, nursery, primary school, and mosque, making it a self-sufficient community. Its well-planned amenities ensure residents enjoy a convenient and fulfilling lifestyle within the neighborhood.

A highlight of the neighborhood is the iconic nine-hole golf course, crafted by renowned Swiss designer Peter Harradine. With a driving range and a clubhouse, this signature feature enhances the charm of life in Living Legends.
